mobalert.screen.title: Mob Alert Settings
mobalert.tooltip.filter: Mobs: animals and monsters / Selected: watched only / All entities: includes boats, arrows, etc.
mobalert.tooltip.enabled: Turns all Mob Alert features on or off.
mobalert.tooltip.glow: Outlines watched mobs, visible through walls. (Hidden by shaders — use Markers instead.)
mobalert.tooltip.hud: Shows nearby watched mobs with direction arrow and distance.
mobalert.tooltip.toast: Shows a popup when a watched mob appears.
mobalert.tooltip.sound: Plays a chime when a watched mob appears.
mobalert.tooltip.chat: Posts a client-only chat message with coordinates when a watched mob appears.
mobalert.toast.title: %s spotted!
mobalert.cmd.list_empty: Nothing watched. Use /mobalert add <entity> or press N.
mobalert.tooltip.map: Shows watched mobs as waypoints on Xaero's minimap and world map. Follows them as they move. (Not saved)
mobalert.tooltip.marker: Shows ▼ name and distance above watched mobs. Works with shaders and through walls.
mobalert.tooltip.pet: Blocks attacks on your own tamed pets. Sneak to attack anyway. (Works on servers: the attack is simply never sent.)
mobalert.tooltip.petsweep: Blocks a sword attack if its sweep would hit your pet. Sprint-attacks don't sweep and go through.
mobalert.pet.blocked: Didn't attack your pet (%s) · sneak to attack anyway
mobalert.pet.blocked_sweep: Blocked: the sweep would hit your pet (%s) · sprint-attack to avoid sweeping
